test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: S1 alone can do a work in 16 days and S2 alone can do the same work in 80 days. With help of S3, they finish the same work in 6 days. In how many days S3 alone can do the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

S1 alone can do a work in 16 days

S2 alone can do the same work in 80 days

With help of S3, they finish the same work in 6 days

**Formula used:**

Total days = Total work / Total efficiency

**Calculation:**

S1 = 16 days

S2 = 80 days

S1 + S2 + S3 = 6 days

Total work = LCM of 16, 80 & 6 = 240 units

Efficiency of S1 = 240/ 16 = 15 units

Efficiency of S2 = 240 / 80 = 3 units 

Efficiency of S1, S2, S3 = 240 / 6 = 40 units.

We have to find the Efficiency of S3,

Total Efficiency of S1, S2 = 15 + 3 = 18 units.

Efficiency of S3 = (Efficiency of S1, S2, S3) - (Efficiency of S1, S2)

⇒ Efficiency of S3 = 40 - 18 = 22 units

Total work completed by S3 (in days) = 240 / 22 = 120/ 11 days.

**∴ S3 alone can do the work in 120/ 11 days.**
